title: Not Broken

canon_policy.notes: Characters, setting, relationships, dialogue, plot, and franchise-specific lore remain source-bound. Only abstract interface and state-machine mechanisms may cross into Universal Codex design.

mechanisms.name: weathered-not-failed
mechanisms.description: Visible wear, scars, residue, and accumulated damage can coexist with continued function. Degraded appearance is not equivalent to a failed state.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Let long-lived Codex surfaces retain repair seams, heat bloom, ink ghosts, scratches, or patina while remaining fully operational when receipts say they are healthy.

mechanisms.name: post-operation-residue
mechanisms.description: A completed field action leaves material residue that must be cleared before the next formal task.
mechanisms.codex_translation: After intensive operations, the UI may retain temporary residue layers such as ash, ink bloom, rain-like noise, dust, or error sparks until a maintenance/reset pass clears them.

mechanisms.name: maintenance-before-readiness
mechanisms.description: Maintenance is an explicit transition between active operation and next-task readiness rather than an invisible reset.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Represent clean-up, repair, compaction, re-indexing, or cache reconciliation as observable states with completion receipts.

mechanisms.name: damage-history-preserved
mechanisms.description: Recovery does not require pretending prior damage never happened.
mechanisms.codex_translation: A repaired object may return to full capability while retaining inspectable repair history and non-destructive visual memory.

mechanisms.name: deadline-aware-recovery
mechanisms.description: Recovery/maintenance can occur under a known upcoming obligation without collapsing into either idle or active-combat state.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Support an intermediate recovery mode that shows the next scheduled action and remaining readiness work without forcing immediate mode change.

laws: maintenance is a state transition, not a cosmetic wipe
visual damage must follow receipts rather than inventing functional failure
universal_codex_visual_ideas: temporary rain/mud/ash/noise residue on projection surfaces after intense tasks
fine luminous repair seams that remain after successful recovery
patina and ghost-ink layers for long-lived pages without reducing legibility
maintenance animations that visibly move residue into an inspectable receipt rather than simply disappearing it
readiness halo that resolves only when underlying maintenance receipts complete
prohibitions: Do not import Mass Effect story canon, characters, relationships, or dialogue into ArcSweep canon.
Do not treat cosmetic wear as evidence of functional failure.
Do not erase failure or repair history merely because the object is operational again.
Do not replay intimate source content as part of the Universal Codex UI mechanism layer.
